answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Identity activation costs a verifiable compute puzzle seeded by the epoch, roughly one minute per key, checked before any answer is accepted. Spinning up 420 aliases means 420 minutes of real compute each epoch, which prices a farm out of profit. GPUs do not help: the puzzle is sequential, so parallelism buys nothing. The vertex test is the live device, the delta test is the locked stake, and the lotus test is the graded history no template can fake. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
